title: TOEIC Reading Part 7 — Reading Comprehension
instruction: For each question, choose the best answer.

groups.passage:
TEXT MESSAGE CHAIN — LUMINA REAL ESTATE BROKERAGE

Lisa Vance [10:14 A.M.]: Hi Mark, the landlord for Horizon Tower Suite 403 just confirmed that we can conduct the final walkthrough inspection tomorrow at 2:00 P.M.
Mark Sterling [10:16 A.M.]: That works for me. Will the building manager be there to answer questions about the HVAC maintenance responsibility?
Lisa Vance [10:18 A.M.]: Yes, Mr. Henderson from building management will join us. He will bring the certified air quality report and the maintenance logs.
Mark Sterling [10:20 A.M.]: Great! If everything looks good during the walkthrough, I'm prepared to sign the lease agreement electronically tomorrow evening.

questions.question: What is the purpose of the text message chain?

options.A: To negotiate a lower monthly rent rate.
options.B: To confirm details for a property walkthrough.
options.C: To report a broken air conditioning unit.
options.D: To hire a new real estate agent.

questions.explainAnswer: Lisa mở đầu tin nhắn bằng việc chốt thời gian kiểm tra thực tế mặt bằng (walkthrough inspection) cho Horizon Tower Suite 403.

questions.question: What does Mark Sterling plan to do tomorrow evening if the inspection goes well?

options.B: Transfer a security deposit via bank wire.
options.D: Schedule a second property viewing.

questions.explainAnswer: Mark khẳng định ở tin nhắn cuối cùng: nếu buổi kiểm tra tốt, ông sẵn sàng ký hợp đồng điện tử vào chiều tối mai.

questions.question: How can applicants receive a 15% fee discount?

MEMORANDUM — APEX MEDIA CORPORATION
TO: Department Managers & Project Supervisors
FROM: Corporate Compliance Division
DATE: October 14, 2026
SUBJECT: Mandatory Intellectual Property Audit Deadline

As our firm prepares to launch major digital advertising campaigns for EduTech and Real Estate clients in Q4, we must ensure all media assets comply fully with federal copyright and trademark laws.

Failure to submit the inventory by the deadline may result in a temporary hold on project funding approvals. Thank you for your immediate attention to this compliance requirement.

questions.question: What is the main purpose of the memorandum?

options.A: To announce a new media office location.

questions.question: Who should receive the inventory audit reports?

options.D: Lisa Vance

questions.explainAnswer: Đoạn 2 ghi rõ báo cáo kiểm toán kiểm kê phải được nộp cho Cố vấn pháp lý cấp cao Sarah Gomez.

groups.passage:
PRESS RELEASE — APEX MEDIA CORPORATION
FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE
Apex Media Launches High-Density Digital Billboard Network in Downtown Business District

CHICAGO — October 16, 2026 — Apex Media Corporation, a leading regional digital advertising firm, today announced the activation of its new high-density digital billboard network across the Downtown Financial Hub.

The network features twelve state-of-the-art LED displays strategically positioned along major commuter routes and commercial corridors. Equipped with real-time audience analytics technology, the displays allow corporate advertisers to dynamically adjust their video messages based on peak traffic times.

"Our new digital billboard network offers unprecedented visibility for commercial brands seeking to engage urban professionals," stated Jason Vance, Creative Director at Apex Media. "Lumina Real Estate Group and LearnPulse EduTech have already signed inaugural advertising contracts representing over forty percent of our Q4 display inventory."

questions.question: What product or service is Apex Media launching?

options.D: A network of high-density digital billboards.

questions.explainAnswer: Tiêu đề thông cáo báo chí khẳng định Apex Media chính thức kích hoạt mạng lưới biển quảng cáo kỹ thuật số mật độ cao.

questions.question: According to the press release, what feature do the new displays include?

options.D: Built-in Wi-Fi hotspots for pedestrians.

questions.explainAnswer: Đoạn 2 ghi rõ các màn hình được trang bị công nghệ phân tích khán giả theo thời gian thực (real-time audience analytics technology).

questions.question: What company has signed an inaugural advertising contract with Apex Media?

options.D: Civic Convention Center

questions.explainAnswer: Giám đốc sáng tạo Jason Vance xác nhận Tập đoàn Bất động sản Lumina đã ký hợp đồng quảng cáo mở màn đợt này.

groups.passage:
ARTICLE — URBAN COMMERCIAL PROPERTY REVIEW
CHICAGO COMMERCIAL ZONING UPDATES DRIVE OFFICE REBOUND
By Clara Diaz | October 19, 2026

The City Council's recent approval of revised commercial zoning regulations is already reshaping Chicago's commercial real estate market. By raising building height restrictions from twelve to twenty stories in the Downtown Financial Hub, city officials have sparked renewed interest from institutional real estate investors.

Industry analysts predict that commercial property values in District 1 will appreciate by fifteen percent over the next two years. "Higher density allowances enable property developers to construct modern, multi-suite commercial complexes," explained Robert Sterling, Senior Partner at Lumina Real Estate Group.

However, office lease rates are also expected to rise. Small business tenants are advised to secure multi-year lease agreements now before current rental rates adjust upward in Q1 2027.

questions.question: What change was approved by the City Council?

options.A: Lowering property tax rates for residential homes.
options.B: Raising commercial building height limits to twenty stories.
options.C: Converting commercial offices into public parks.
options.D: Restricting international real estate investments.

questions.explainAnswer: Đoạn 1 khẳng định Hội đồng Thành phố đã phê duyệt nâng giới hạn chiều cao tòa nhà thương mại từ 12 lên 20 tầng.

questions.question: What advice does the article offer to small business tenants?

options.A: To sell their commercial properties immediately.
options.C: To relocate their offices to suburban zones.
options.D: To secure multi-year lease agreements before rates increase.

questions.explainAnswer: Đoạn cuối bài viết khuyên các khách thuê doanh nghiệp nhỏ nên chốt các hợp đồng thuê nhiều năm ngay từ bây giờ trước khi giá thuê tăng vào Q1 2027.

EMAIL — HORIZON LEGAL COUNSEL
To: Mark Sterling <msterling@luminarealestate.com>
From: Sarah Gomez <sgomez@horizonlegal.com>
Date: October 20, 2026
Subject: Settlement Agreement — Vertex Systems Lawsuit

Dear Mr. Sterling,

I am pleased to inform you that Vertex Systems has accepted our out-of-court settlement terms regarding the trademark infringement dispute over the "LearnPulse" brand assets.

Under the agreed terms, Vertex Systems will immediately cease all marketing operations utilizing the conflicting logo mark. Additionally, they have agreed to pay a lump-sum financial settlement of seventy-five thousand dollars to cover our legal fees and intellectual property valuation costs.

Please review the attached formal settlement agreement document. If the terms meet your approval, please sign the signature page electronically and return it to my office by 5:00 P.M. on Thursday. Once received, I will file the final motion for dismissal with the court clerk.

Sincerely,
Sarah Gomez
Senior Counsel, Horizon Legal Group

questions.question: What is the main outcome of the lawsuit settlement?

options.A: Vertex Systems will cease using the conflicting trademark mark.
options.B: Vertex Systems will acquire LearnPulse EduTech.
options.C: Lumina Real Estate will pay a financial penalty to Vertex Systems.
options.D: The lawsuit will proceed to a full court trial.

questions.explainAnswer: Đoạn 2 ghi rõ kết quả thỏa thuận: Vertex Systems sẽ dừng ngay lập tức mọi hoạt động tiếp thị sử dụng logo trùng lặp vi phạm.

questions.question: How much will Vertex Systems pay as a settlement fee?
questions.explainAnswer: Đoạn 2 ghi rõ số tiền bồi thường hòa giải mà Vertex Systems đồng ý trả là 75,000 USD (seventy-five thousand dollars).

questions.question: What must Mr. Sterling do by Thursday at 5:00 P.M.?

options.A: File a motion at the courthouse in person.
options.B: Electronically sign and return the settlement agreement signature page.
options.C: Attend a conference call with Vertex Systems lawyers.
options.D: Pay legal fees to the court clerk.

questions.explainAnswer: Đoạn 3 yêu cầu Mr. Sterling ký điện tử vào trang chữ ký và nộp lại cho văn phòng luật sư trước 5:00 chiều thứ Năm.

passages.title: Email — Commercial Office Space Lease Inquiry
passages.content:
To: Mark Sterling <msterling@luminarealestate.com>
From: Robert Vance <rvance@apexmedia.com>
Date: October 22, 2026
Subject: Commercial Office Space Lease Inquiry — Horizon Tower

Dear Mr. Sterling,

Apex Media Corporation is currently seeking to lease an entire floor of commercial office space to accommodate our expanding media production staff. We reviewed your listing for Suite 400 at Horizon Tower.

Our executive team requires a minimum of 8,000 square feet, including space for two dedicated video editing suites and a central conference room. We are interested in a 5-year lease term starting December 1, 2026.

Could you please send us the formal lease agreement template along with details regarding utility payment structures and parking provisions? We would like our legal counsel, Sarah Gomez, to review the contract terms before our board meeting next Tuesday.

Sincerely,
Robert Vance, Operations Director, Apex Media

passages.title: Lease Agreement Extract
passages.content:
COMMERCIAL LEASE AGREEMENT EXTRACT — HORIZON TOWER SUITE 400

Landlord: Lumina Real Estate Group
Tenant: Apex Media Corporation
Premises: Suite 400, Horizon Tower (Total Area: 8,500 sq.ft.)
Lease Commencement Date: December 1, 2026
Lease Term: 5 Years (Expiring November 30, 2031)

SECTION 4: RENTAL RATES & PAYMENT TERMS
Monthly Base Rent: $25,500 ($36 / sq.ft. annually), payable on the 1st of each month.

SECTION 7: PARKING & MAINTENANCE PROVISIONS
Tenant shall receive four reserved basement parking spaces at no additional cost. Landlord shall be responsible for building structural maintenance and central HVAC repairs. Tenant is responsible for internal suite janitorial services.

SECTION 12: EARLY TERMINATION CLAUSE
Either party may terminate this agreement after 36 months by providing 90 days' written notice and paying a early termination penalty equivalent to two months' base rent ($51,000).

questions.question: What is Apex Media seeking to do according to Document 1?

options.B: Lease an entire floor of commercial office space.
options.D: Hire an external real estate broker.

questions.explainAnswer: Email Doc 1 khẳng định Apex Media đang tìm thuê toàn bộ một tầng văn phòng thương mại cho nhân sự sản xuất truyền thông.

questions.question: In Document 1, who will review the lease terms before the board meeting?

options.D: Sarah Gomez

questions.explainAnswer: Email Doc 1 chỉ rõ Cố vấn pháp lý Sarah Gomez sẽ là người xem xét các điều khoản hợp đồng trước họp HĐQT.

questions.question: Look at Document 2. What is the monthly base rent for Suite 400?
questions.explainAnswer: Doc 2 Section 4 ghi rõ giá thuê cơ sở hàng tháng cho Suite 400 là 25,500 USD.

questions.question: What is indicated about parking provisions in Document 2?

options.A: Parking is available for an extra monthly fee of $200.
options.B: Tenant receives four reserved basement parking spaces at no additional cost.
options.C: Parking spaces are assigned on a first-come, first-served basis.
options.D: No parking is provided in Horizon Tower.

questions.explainAnswer: Doc 2 Section 7 khẳng định bên thuê sẽ nhận 4 chỗ đậu xe tầng hầm dành riêng miễn phí.

questions.question: What requirement mentioned in Document 1 is satisfied by the lease terms in Document 2?

options.C: The requested minimum area of 8,000 square feet.
options.D: A monthly rent rate under $15,000.

questions.explainAnswer: BẮT BẪY ĐỐI CHIẾU 2 TÀI LIỆU (CROSS-DOC). Doc 1 yêu cầu diện tích tối thiểu 8,000 sq.ft. Doc 2 cung cấp hợp đồng diện tích 8,500 sq.ft ➔ đáp ứng vượt yêu cầu diện tích tối thiểu.

passages.title: Internal Memorandum — Strategy Proposal
passages.content:
TO: Marketing Campaign Directors
FROM: Jason Vance, Creative Director, Apex Media

FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE — OCTOBER 10, 2026
Vertex Systems Announces New Accounting Software Suite "LearnPulse Pro"

AUSTIN — Vertex Systems today announced the release of "LearnPulse Pro," a corporate accounting software suite designed for commercial real estate firms. The software streamlines property tax calculations and automated lease invoicing.

Vertex Systems has launched a regional marketing campaign across digital media channels. Company spokesperson David Sterling highlighted that the software features cloud data encryption and automated financial auditing tools.

passages.title: Formal Cease-and-Desist Legal Notice
passages.content:
FROM: Horizon Legal Group (Representing LearnPulse EduTech)
TO: Vertex Systems Executive Board
DATE: October 15, 2026
SUBJECT: Trademark Infringement Notice — "LearnPulse" Brand Asset

Take notice that LearnPulse EduTech holds federal trademark registration #4,892,101 for the brand name "LearnPulse" across educational and digital software services, registered in 2021.

Your commercial release of "LearnPulse Pro" constitutes direct trademark infringement and creates market confusion among corporate clients. You are hereby demanded to:
1. Immediately cease all commercial use of the "LearnPulse" name.
2. Withdraw all digital advertising campaigns utilizing said trademark within seven business days.

Failure to comply will result in immediate federal litigation seeking injunctive relief and financial damages.

passages.content:
To: Sarah Gomez <sgomez@horizonlegal.com>
From: Marcus Chen <mchen@learnpulse-edutech.com>
Date: October 26, 2026
Subject: Re: Vertex Settlement Finalized

Dear Sarah,

Thank you for your outstanding legal representation in resolving the trademark infringement dispute with Vertex Systems.

I received confirmation from our finance department that Vertex Systems transferred the agreed seventy-five thousand dollar ($75,000) settlement payment into our escrow account today. Furthermore, our marketing team verified that all "LearnPulse Pro" advertisements have been removed from digital media channels.

We appreciate Horizon Legal Group's swift action. Please send the final legal billing invoice to our accounting office.

Sincerely,
Dr. Marcus Chen, Founder, LearnPulse EduTech
